input.command:
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -3; d=$(mktemp -d) && cat > $d/repro.py <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from store import Store
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
from cleanup import cleanup_setup
s = Store()
begin_setup(s, "w", "failed")          # failed job leaves pending record
begin_setup(s, "w", "two")
complete_setup(s, "w", "two", "connection-two")  # newer setup completes first
cleanup_setup(s, "w", "failed")        # queued cleanup for failed job runs
print("pending:", s.pending, "active:", active_connection(s, "w"))
EOF
echo "--- staged candidate"; python3 -B $d/repro.py "$PWD"
b=$(mktemp -d) && for f in store.py setup.py cleanup.py; do git show HEAD:$f > $b/$f; done
echo "--- HEAD baseline"; python3 -B $d/repro.py "$b"
input.description: Run tests and reproduce cleanup race scenario
